    owner = { is_alive = yes }
    has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
    OR = { is_domicile_type = east_asian_estate }
    NOT = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = east_asian_estate_ancestral_shrine_01 }
    OR = {
        has_domicile_building_or_higher = east_asian_estate_ancestral_shrine_01
        free_external_domicile_building_slots > 0
    }
}

    owner = { is_alive = yes }
    has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
    OR = { is_domicile_type = camp }
    NOT = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = proving_grounds_bodyguard_drills }
    OR = {
        has_domicile_building_or_higher = proving_grounds_bodyguard_drills
        AND = {
            has_domicile_building_or_higher = proving_grounds_01
            domicile_building_has_free_internal_slot = proving_grounds_01
        }
    }
}

    owner = { is_alive = yes }
    has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
    OR = { is_domicile_type = estate }
    NOT = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = grain_field_02 }
    OR = {
        has_domicile_building_or_higher = grain_field_01
        free_external_domicile_building_slots > 0
    }
}

    owner = { is_alive = yes }
    has_ongoing_domicile_construction = no
    OR = { is_domicile_type = japanese_manor }
    NOT = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = japanese_law_library_02 }
    OR = {
        has_domicile_building_or_higher = japanese_law_library_01
        AND = {
            has_domicile_building_or_higher = japanese_archive_01
            domicile_building_has_free_internal_slot = japanese_archive_01
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_matches_filter = {
    OR = {
        scope:DI_dm_player = {
            OR = { NOT = { has_variable = DI_dm_filter_choice } var:DI_dm_filter_choice = flag:DI_dm_filter_all }
        }
        AND = {
            is_domicile_type = camp
            scope:DI_dm_player = { var:DI_dm_filter_choice = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_camp }
        }
        AND = {
            is_domicile_type = east_asian_estate
            scope:DI_dm_player = { var:DI_dm_filter_choice = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_east_asian_estate }
        }
        AND = {
            is_domicile_type = ecclesiastical_domicile
            scope:DI_dm_player = { var:DI_dm_filter_choice = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_ecclesiastical_domicile }
        }
        AND = {
            is_domicile_type = estate
            scope:DI_dm_player = { var:DI_dm_filter_choice = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_estate }
        }
        AND = {
            is_domicile_type = japanese_manor
            scope:DI_dm_player = { var:DI_dm_filter_choice = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_japanese_manor }
        }
        AND = {
            is_domicile_type = yurt
            scope:DI_dm_player = { var:DI_dm_filter_choice = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_yurt }
        }
    }
}
